title: Listing coverage for all eight reporting customers: find, confirm and watch our product pages at Game, Makro, Computer Mania, Incredible Connection, HiFi Corp, Evetech, Takealot and Amazon
acceptance_criteria: Warren 2026-10-07: listing intelligence is needed for all reporting customers, not only Takealot and Evetech
For every product a reporting customer sells (from CST rows), CIP proposes that retailer's product page found by EAN or model on the retailer's own site; a steward confirms; nothing auto-registers
One page reader per retailer extracts price, stock, title, images, description and specs from the stored snapshot
Fetching respects robots rules, uses per-retailer spacing, and stops on 403/429; refusals are recorded, not retried hard
Amazon's 51 registered listings are linked to products or flagged
Coverage view: per customer, products sold vs listings watched
Tests green on touched areas, tsc exit 0, eslint clean on changed files
